name: HiDream O1 Image
summary: HiDream O1 full image model for PocketAI's local CUDA runtime. Large bf16 snapshot with strong prompt adherence and high-detail images; requires a high-VRAM NVIDIA GPU.

name: HiDream O1 Image Dev
summary: HiDream O1 Dev image model for PocketAI's local CUDA runtime. Faster distilled path with the same large snapshot footprint; requires a high-VRAM NVIDIA GPU.

name: Krea 2 Turbo
summary: Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image model for PocketAI's local CUDA Diffusers runtime. Distilled 8-step safetensors path with strong prompt adherence; requires a high-VRAM NVIDIA GPU.

name: Stable Diffusion 1.5
summary: Smallest image gen model. Fast on phones and desktops. Generates 512x512 images with good quality for its size.

name: SDXL Turbo
summary: Very fast image generation in just 4 steps. Good quality at 512x512. Great for quick iterations on newer phones and desktops.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium
summary: Best quality-to-size ratio for image gen. Generates 1024x1024 images with strong prompt adherence and fine detail.

name: SDXL Lightning
summary: Lightning-fast SDXL distilled to 4 steps. Generates 1024x1024 images in under a second on desktop GPUs. Excellent quality for its speed.

name: Z-Image Turbo
summary: Blazing fast 6B model — 10x faster than FLUX with ~95% of the quality. Excellent bilingual text rendering (EN/CN). Only 3.7 GB. Apache 2.0.

name: SDXL Base 1.0
summary: Full-quality SDXL with 20-step generation. Produces detailed 1024x1024 images with strong prompt adherence. Desktop only.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large
summary: 8B-parameter MMDiT model. Major step up from SD 3.5 Medium with superior prompt understanding, typography, and fine detail at 1024x1024.

name: SD 3.5 Large Turbo
summary: Fast 4-step generation with 8B-parameter quality. Uses adversarial diffusion distillation for rapid high-quality output at 1024x1024.

name: Z-Image Base
summary: Full 6B model for maximum quality. Exceptional prompt adherence and photorealism at 1024x1024. Pairs with Qwen3-4B text encoder. Apache 2.0.

name: Z-Anime
summary: Anime-style fine-tune of Z-Image Base (6B). Strong anime aesthetics with the same prompt-adherence backbone as Z-Image. Pairs with Qwen3-4B text encoder. Apache 2.0.

name: FLUX.1 Schnell
summary: State-of-the-art image generation in just 4 steps. Exceptional prompt understanding and photorealistic output. Desktop only — needs significant memory.

name: FLUX.1 Dev
summary: High-quality FLUX.1 model for eligible non-commercial and non-production use. Review the BFL license before installing.

name: Chroma1 HD Flash
summary: Fast distilled Chroma model. 8.9B FLUX-based architecture generating high-quality images in ~8 steps. Great speed-to-quality ratio. Apache 2.0.

name: Chroma1 HD
summary: 8.9B FLUX-based model tuned for HD image quality. Excellent prompt adherence, typography, and fine detail. 40-step generation at 1024x1024. Apache 2.0.

name: Ovis-Image 7B
summary: 7B model that punches above its weight — text rendering accuracy (0.92) beats 20B Qwen-Image (0.83) and GPT-4o (0.86). Built on FLUX architecture. Great for typography-heavy content.

name: Chroma1 Radiance
summary: 10B pixel-space diffusion model — no VAE needed. Works directly on image pixels for exceptional detail and coherence. 40-step generation. Apache 2.0.

name: Qwen-Image
summary: 20B MMDiT — the text-to-image king. Dominates text rendering benchmarks (96.8 vs FLUX's 84.5). Best overall open-source image quality. Needs 24 GB+ RAM.

name: Qwen-Image 2512
summary: December 2025 Qwen-Image update with stronger human realism, finer natural detail, and improved bilingual text rendering. Very high quality, but slow and memory-heavy.

name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B True V3
summary: V3 fine-tune of FLUX.2 Klein 9B with improved aesthetics, composition, prompt-only image editing, and low-loss GGUF quantization. Uses the FLUX.2 Qwen3 8B text encoder and supports fast four-step generation.

name: Krea 2 Turbo HD V1
summary: Krea 2 Turbo HD fine-tune for detailed, photorealistic text-to-image generation. Runs its pinned GGUF diffusion weights through ComfyUI in eight steps; includes Q4, Q6, and Q8 variants.

name: Krea 2 Turbo Alis MLX 8-bit
summary: Pre-quantized 8-bit Krea 2 Turbo for Apple Silicon. Uses a pinned MLX pipeline and locally downloaded Krea VAE, Qwen3-VL text encoder, and tokenizer components for eight-step generation.

name: FLUX.1 Dev MLX 4-bit
summary: Pre-quantized 4-bit FLUX.1 Dev snapshot for Apple Silicon. Runs through PocketAI's pinned MFLUX runtime with substantially lower storage and unified-memory requirements than the original weights.

name: Qwen-Image 2512 MLX 4-bit
summary: Pre-quantized 4-bit Qwen-Image 2512 snapshot for Apple Silicon. Runs locally through PocketAI's pinned MFLUX runtime with negative-prompt support and strong prompt adherence.

name: FLUX.2 Klein Base 4B MLX
summary: Full bf16 MLX conversion of FLUX.2 Klein Base 4B for Apple Silicon. A complete local snapshot with the Qwen3 text encoder, transformer, tokenizer, scheduler, and VAE.

name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
summary: Apache-2.0 FLUX.2 distilled model for fast four-step text-to-image and reference-image editing. Compact Q4_0 diffusion weights paired with the Qwen3 4B text encoder.

name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
summary: Apache-2.0 reference-image editor with strong identity consistency, text editing, industrial design, and geometric reasoning. Requires an input image and substantial memory.

name: Bonsai Image Ternary 4B MLX
summary: Ternary 1.58-bit FLUX.2 Klein 4B image model for Apple Silicon. Its packed transformer and 4-bit MLX text encoder target a much smaller memory footprint than the full-precision pipeline.

name: FLUX.2 Dev
summary: Catalog-only FLUX.2 Dev listing pending runtime and release-safety validation. Full Dev requires the Mistral Small 3.2 24B text encoder (not Qwen3-8B), a separate VAE, and substantially more memory than the transformer file alone. The open weights are non-commercial; review the upstream license before use.
